case.title: LWCs are droppable on an Experience Cloud page

steps.text: Read the component metadata for both LWCs.
Check whether the org has an Experience Cloud site at all.

records.label: Experience Cloud sites

observations: HANDOFF open item 1, and the remainder of the licensing argument for the whole split: the components are ready for a site that does not exist. The org Experience licence count is still unverified.
expected: cafEvidence and cafAttestation carry the lightningCommunity__Page target.
Blocked, not failed: there is no Experience Cloud site to drop them on.
actual: No Experience Cloud in this org — querying Network failed: SOQL failed:
